import hookenv
from charms.reactive.bus import get_state
from charms.layer.jenkins.api import Api
from charms.layer.jenkins.configuration import Configuration
from charms.layer.jenkins.plugins import Plugins, PluginSiteError
from charms.layer.jenkins.users import Users
from charms.layer.jenkins.credentials import Credentials
from charms.layer.jenkins.service import Service
from charms.layer.jenkins.storage import Storage
from charms.layer.jenkins.packages import Packages
from charmhelpers.core import unitdata
from charmhelpers.core.host import service_restart, service_start, service_stop


def install_dependencies(jenkins_version=None):
    packages = Packages()
    packages.install_dependencies(jenkins_version=jenkins_version)


def _get_plugins_layer():
    try:
        plugins = Plugins()
    except PluginSiteError as e:
        hookenv.status_set("error", e.message)
        raise
    return plugins


def upgrade_jenkins_bundle():
    packages = Packages()
    if packages.jenkins_upgradable():
        hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Upgrading Jenkins")
        packages.install_dependencies()
        packages.install_jenkins()
        api = Api()
        api.wait()
        packages.clean_old_plugins()
        unitdata.kv().set("jenkins.plugins.last_update", 0)
        _set_state_for_plugins_update()
    else:
        hookenv.log("No newer jenkins package is available")


def _set_state_for_plugins_update():
    remove_state("jenkins.configured.plugins")


def bootstrap_jenkins_state():
    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Bootstrapping Jenkins configuration")
    service = Service()
    service.check_ready()
    configuration = Configuration()
    if configuration.bootstrap():
        set_state("jenkins.bootstrapped")


def configure_admin_state():
    remove_state("jenkins.configured.admin")
    api = Api()

    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Configuring Jenkins public url")
    configuration = Configuration()
    configuration.set_url()
    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Restarting Jenkins")
    service_restart("jenkins")
    api.wait()

    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Configuring admin user")
    users = Users()
    users.configure_admin()

    api.reload()
    api.wait()

    if get_state("extension.connected"):
        from charms.reactive import RelationBase
        extension_relation = RelationBase.from_state("extension.connected")
        extension_relation.joined()

    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Configuring proxy settings")
    configuration.configure_proxy()
    service_restart("jenkins")
    api.wait()

    set_state("jenkins.configured.admin")


def configure_plugins_state():
    if get_state("extension.connected"):
        hookenv.log("External relation detected - skip configuring plugins")
        return
    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Configuring plugins")
    remove_state("jenkins.configured.plugins")
    plugins = _get_plugins_layer()
    plugins.backup()
    try:
        installed_plugins, incompatible_plugins = plugins.install(hookenv.config("plugins"))
        _check_incompatible_plugins(incompatible_plugins)
    except Exception as err:
        hookenv.log(
            "Unknown error encountered while installing plugins, restoring jenkins "
            "to previous state. Error was: %s" % str(err),
            "ERROR",
        )
        recover_jenkins(plugins)
    set_state("jenkins.configured.plugins")
    unitdata.kv().set("jenkins.plugins.last_update", time.time())


def _check_incompatible_plugins(incompatible_plugins):
    if len(incompatible_plugins) != 0:
        hookenv.log(
            "The following plugins require a higher jenkins version"
            " and were not installed: (%s)" % " ".join(incompatible_plugins)
        )
        hookenv.status_set(
            "blocked",
            "There were plugins not compatible with this"
            " jenkins version. Consider upgrading jenkins or removing"
            " the plugins.",
        )


def recover_jenkins(plugins):
    hookenv.log("Jenkins api is unresponsive, trying to recover it.")
    api = Api()
    plugins.restore()
    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Restarting Jenkins")
    service_restart("jenkins")
    api.wait()
    plugins.clean_backup()


def configure_update_center():
    hookenv.log("Modifying Update Center url")
    api = Api()
    api.set_update_center(hookenv.config("update-center"))


def configure_update_center_ca():
    hookenv.log("Saving Update Center CA")
    configuration = Configuration()
    configuration.set_update_center_ca()


def set_jenkins_dir(storage_dir=None):
    storage_dir = storage_dir or Storage().home_path()
    hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Configuring Jenkins storage")
    jenkins_installed = get_state("apt.installed.jenkins")
    if jenkins_installed:
        service_stop("jenkins")

    if storage_dir == Storage().home_path():
        hookenv.log("Setting Jenkins to use local storage")
        Storage().unlink_home()
    else:
        hookenv.log("Setting Jenkins to use storage at {}".format(storage_dir))
        Storage().link_home(storage_dir)

    if jenkins_installed:
        hookenv.status_set("maintenance", "Restarting Jenkins")
        service_start("jenkins")
        Service().check_ready()

    if get_state("jenkins.bootstrapped"):
        remove_state("jenkins.bootstrapped")
        bootstrap_jenkins_state()
    else:
        hookenv.status_set("active", "Ready")
